gate: Watch how a person carrying this code returns to the same thought four times in an afternoon, each pass slightly different, each pass picking at a seam that did not quite resolve last time. This is the re-tweaking gate. The drive is to understand the why under things, to keep working a question until the shape of an answer comes loose. The work is iterative on purpose. A first read is never the final read. The mind goes back, turns the material, looks at it from another angle, then goes back again. Most people misread this as indecision or as not being able to let things go. That misses what is actually happening. Nothing was meant to land cleanly the first time. The code is built to keep tweaking, and the gold falls out of the third or fourth pass, not the first.
centre_field: Picture the Ajna as an upside-down triangle tucked just below the head, the body's processing room where raw pressure gets turned into something usable. That placement is the whole teaching. The rationalising is not a personality quirk to be apologised for. It is wired to the seat of analysis itself, and the gate is one of the specific channels through which the centre does its work. The teaching, sharp, is that this centre is not a decision-making centre. Information is what it produces. Clarity, sometimes. Certainty, occasionally. None of that is the same as a decision. The code runs into trouble when it tries to use the rationalising itself as a verdict, when the mind decides because the mind is the loudest voice in the room. The processing is meant to feed something else, not to rule.
channel: A gate is one end of an arc. This one reaches up toward the gate of mystery in the centre above, the head centre, and the two together form the channel of awareness, sometimes called the channel of the thinker. The reach is what makes the work coherent. Mystery alone is unbearable pressure, a question with no way to be turned. Rationalising alone is grinding on nothing, a mind chewing on its own teeth. The pairing gives the pressure something to work on and gives the working something worth pressing toward. The mystery feeds the rationale the material it actually needs. The rationale gives the mystery a shape it can be turned in. Alone, this code grinds. Joined, it becomes the patient inner work of making sense of what does not yet have a name.
